Each row is ONE different hand-drawn animation progressing left to right: anticipation, rising energy, peak impact, dissipating shards. Match polished Korean 2D pixel RPG effects, crisp chunky pixel clusters and detailed bright highlights, not flat geometric placeholder shapes. Row1: steel twin dagger X-cut with short ivory spark splinters and charcoal smoke tails (rookie rogue). Row2: crimson narrow assassination thrust with curved dark dagger, red scar slit and bloodlike red crystal sparks (assassin). Row4: violet twin shadow blades sweeping from opposite sides with dark purple fabriclike wisps and spectral trailing silhouettes, NO ghosts, NO skeletons (shadow dancer). Row5: emerald venom needles, hanging viscous green drops converging into a toxic crystalline starburst then droplets (poisoner); no ordinary flames. Row6: cyan translucent ornate playing cards and cracked porcelain theatrical half-mask, two mirrored ghostly rapier thrusts, spectral white ribbons (phantom), distinctly unlike row3 and row4. Row7: orange mechanical fragmentation bomb bursting with steel casing fragments, yellow-white ignition core, orange flame lobes and heavy gray smoke, no magical symbols (saboteur). Every row must look distinctly different in silhouette, material, and motion. 4 columns, 7 rows. Transparent alpha background throughout, especially all margins. Aim canvas 1024x1792 or proportional.
